text: The initiative marked several firsts, including being the first sovereign-sponsored catastrophe bond from Asia and the first World Bank bond listed on the Singapore Exchange. The bonds feature a modeled-loss trigger mechanism, allowing for quick payouts without lengthy claims processes. The stepwise payout design offers clarity on financial relief based on the severity of the disaster, and the fixed premium ensures cost predictability over the bond's term.

metadata.solution_name: IBRD Catastrophe Bonds for Earthquakes and Tropical Cyclones
